# Clavis 3.7

## ✨ New

- **Clavis for Linux.** A `.deb` package for Ubuntu, Debian and similar 64-bit systems, with the same encryption, the same vaults and the same `.enc` files as on Windows. Encrypt on one, open on the other. Install it with `sudo apt install ./Clavis-linux.deb`. On Linux, update by installing the newer `.deb`. The command line is at `/opt/clavis/bin/clavis-cli`. The Explorer right-click menu is Windows-only.
- **Tamil and Hindi** (first drafts). Settings → **Language** → தமிழ் or हिन्दी, then restart Clavis. The main screens, the sidebar and Settings are translated so far; the rest still shows in English. If you speak Tamil or Hindi, corrections are very welcome at clavis.enc@gmail.com.

## Install / upgrade

- **Windows, already installed:** the app updates itself (Settings → Updates → Check now).
- **New install:** download **Clavis-Setup.exe** (Windows) or **Clavis-linux.deb** (Linux) from the website.

Your vaults and settings are kept.
